resources.string: Remind me to review this follow-up at %1$s?

This is your chosen time to review the journal, not a clinical test or treatment interval. Check-ins do not cancel the reminder. Pausing, ending or deleting the journal, changing its goal or revising the visit requires a new confirmation. Existing treatment reminders are not changed.
Review the updated visit and journal before scheduling another reminder.
A follow-up review is ready. Open Personal Health.
